name: ActivityPub
description: Connects a Drupal site with the Fediverse (ActivityPub). NOTE: inbound signature verification is incomplete in this alpha.
project_description:
Implements the ActivityPub protocol for your site. Users on the Fediverse will be able to follow content from your site on Mastodon and other federated platforms that support the ActivityPub protocol. Responses are possible too (Reply, Like, Announce) with much more to come.

 The module is able to communicate with the following federated platforms:

 
 Mastodon 
 Pixelfed 
 Pleroma 
 GoToSocial 
 Hubzilla 
 Write.as 
 
 Open an issue if you have successfully interacted with other platforms or let us know on #drupalactivitypub:matrix.org

 This module mainly acts as a server. If you want a client, you can install the Personal reader project, which allows you to view and interact with followers. Or you can use a mobile, web or desktop client to connect with the Mastodon-API compatible endpoint available in this module. A list of tested clients can be found in the here .

 Check the README for all features, installation and configuration.
